task.description:
Implement the gated design in `lib/letflow/design/iss-0119-status-file-readability.md` §13.6/§13.12 (A5's closed-and-pinned rule, the new shared A10 closure-warranted assertion). Read the design's own §13.12.4/§13.12.5 in full for the exact specification -- signatures, exact function names, and the sharing requirement -- rather than re-deriving it; this dispatch summarizes only enough to size the work.

WHAT TO IMPLEMENT, per the design's own spec:

1. `test/support/status_history.ex`: add `warranted_closure?(volume, max_lines, max_bytes) :: boolean()` -- reads the volume's own recorded `lines:`/`bytes_working_tree:` fields (the index's closure-time snapshot, never a live re-measurement of the file) and returns true only when at least one exceeds its ceiling AND the volume's `status:` is `closed`. Rename/extend the existing `closed_and_pinned?/2` (used today only by A4b) to `closed_pinned_and_warranted?(volumes, roll_rule, record) :: boolean()`, delegating to `warranted_closure?/3` -- both A4b's and the new A5 finding must call this ONE shared function, never two separate implementations of the same comparison. Add a `disqualifying_reason/3` helper returning one of `:not_closed | :not_pinned | :not_warranted` (or `nil` if none apply) for use in assertion failure messages.

2. `test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs`: add the new A10 test (continuing the file's own A1-A9 numbering) asserting `closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3` for every existing `known_anomalies:`/`known_shape_anomalies:` record. Update A4b's existing test call site to use the renamed/extended function. Add at least one NEGATIVE-CONTROL fixture: a volume that is closed and pinned but whose recorded size does NOT exceed `roll_rule` -- confirm the new assertion correctly FAILS for it (this is the MINOR-4 laundering scenario the design's A10 exists specifically to block; a test suite that only exercises the positive case would not actually prove the fix works). A second negative control for the un-warranted-A5 case (a `known_anomalies:` record citing an open/current volume) should ALSO fail under the new rule -- if such a fixture does not already exist from A4b's own prior test, add one.

3. RUN THE SUITE YOURSELF before marking this step done. `mix test test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs` (or the project's standard test invocation) and quote the real output -- pass/fail counts, not a summary. If `mix` needs a working Postgres and one isn't available in this environment, say so explicitly per `docs/anti-patterns.md`'s documented fallback rather than reporting untested code as done.

4. Confirm the three EXISTING legitimate `known_anomalies:` records (and A4b's existing `known_shape_anomalies:` records, if any) still pass under the new shared function -- this is a regression check on top of the new positive/negative-control tests.

CONSTRAINTS:
- This design is TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY. No `lib/letflow/` or `priv/repo/migrations/` file is touched by this step -- if you find yourself needing to, stop and report it as a BLOCKER rather than expanding scope.
- Do not weaken A5's existing bidirectional set-equality assertion or touch the three existing `known_anomalies:` records in `docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml`.
- `result.status` must be one of PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/SKIPPED.
- Read the clock in its OWN command before each timestamp.
- Claim by setting `status` to `IN_PROGRESS` only, and set it to `COMPLETED`/`FAILED` yourself when you finish -- per `HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md` §3's table, this is your field to flip both ways.
- Commit to this branch (`feature/WF03-ISS0193-20260821`), not `main`. Commit `test/` and this handoff.
acceptance_criteria: warranted_closure?/3 is implemented per the design's spec, comparing the index-recorded closure-time snapshot, never a live file re-measurement

closed_and_pinned?/2 is renamed/extended to closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3, delegating to warranted_closure?/3, and is the ONLY implementation both A4b's and A5's findings call -- no duplicated comparison logic
disqualifying_reason/3 is implemented returning one of :not_closed | :not_pinned | :not_warranted | nil
The new A10 test exists, continuing the file's existing A1-A9 numbering, asserting every known_anomalies:/known_shape_anomalies: record passes closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3

At least one negative-control fixture proves the MINOR-4 laundering scenario (closed, pinned, but NOT warranted) correctly fails the new assertion, and at least one proves an open-volume known_anomalies: record correctly fails A5's rule

mix test was actually run and its real output (pass/fail counts) is quoted in result.summary -- or the environment's inability to run it is stated explicitly per docs/anti-patterns.md, never asserted as passing without having run
The three existing known_anomalies: records (and any existing known_shape_anomalies: records) are confirmed to still pass under the new shared function
No file under lib/letflow/ or priv/repo/migrations/ is touched

result.summary:
Implemented design SS13.6/SS13.12 exactly. test/support/status_history.ex gained warranted_closure?/3 (reads the index's own recorded lines:/bytes_working_tree: snapshot, never a live re-measurement; raises via Map.fetch!/2 rather than defaulting on a status:closed volume missing either field). test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs: renamed/extended the private closed_and_pinned?/2 to closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3 (delegates to SH.warranted_closure?/3), added disqualifying_reason/3 (:not_closed | :not_pinned | :not_warranted | nil), added the new A10 test after A9, updated A4b's call site to thread roll_rule through, and extended A5's own test block to assert closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3 over every known_anomalies: record with an extended failure message. Added: (1) an A10 negative control proving the MINOR-4 laundering scenario (closed+pinned but NOT warranted) fails; (2) an A5 negative control proving a record citing an open/current volume fails; (3) three DIRECT unit tests on SH.warranted_closure?/3 targeting its three individual traps (either- vs both-ceiling, dropped status gate, silently-defaulted vs raised missing field) -- the A10/negative-control fixtures alone (fully-under or fully-over ceiling) could not discriminate those traps.

Real mix test output, test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs only (mix at '/c/Program Files/Elixir/bin/mix', Postgres reachable -- 'QUERY OK' lines confirm a live DB connection; the placeholder-keycloak metadata-load error is pre-existing and unrelated):
  Clean run: 'Finished in 0.5 seconds ... Result: 20 passed' (0 failures). This is 14 pre-existing tests (A0,A1,A2,A3,A3b,A4a,A4b,A4b-neg1,A4b-neg2,A5,A6,A7,A8,A9) + 6 new (A10, A10-negative-control, A5-negative-control, and the 3 direct warranted_closure?/3 unit tests).

MUTATION TESTING (WF-03's 'code under test did not exist' rule applies -- warranted_closure?/3 and closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3 are BOTH NEW): mutated test/support/status_history.ex's warranted_closure?/3 in place, ran the full file after each mutant, then reverted with `git checkout -- test/support/status_history.ex` and re-verified `git status --porcelain test/ lib/` empty plus a clean 20/20 re-run before moving to the next mutant.
  Mutant 1 (ceiling 'or' -> 'and', i.e. require BOTH lines and bytes over instead of either): 18/20 passed, 2 failed (the direct 'EITHER ceiling exceeded is sufficient' test, and the direct missing-field raise test whose second case now short-circuits false on lines instead of reaching bytes_working_tree).
  Mutant 2 (dropped the `status == "closed"` gate entirely): 19/20 passed, 1 failed (the direct 'a non-closed volume is never warranted' test).
  Mutant 3 (Map.fetch! -> Map.get(_, 0), i.e. silently default a missing field instead of raising): 19/20 passed, 1 failed (the direct 'raises rather than silently defaulting' test).
  All three reverted; `git status --porcelain test/ lib/` empty after each revert, and the suite was re-run green (20/20) after the final revert -- confirmed above.

Regression check: the three existing known_anomalies: records (lines 74-94 of docs/status/requirement_status.index.yaml) and the three existing known_shape_anomalies: records all still pass under the new shared closed_pinned_and_warranted?/3 (A4b and A5 both green in the 20/20 run) -- volume 1's index-recorded lines:5766/bytes_working_tree:361376 exceed roll_rule's 1200/120000 ceilings, so it independently satisfies A10 too, per the design's own SS13.12.2 verification.

No file under lib/letflow/ or priv/repo/migrations/ was touched -- confirmed via `git diff --stat main...HEAD -- lib/ priv/repo/migrations/`, which shows only the design doc (from an earlier step) and no code file.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR. Per WF-03's 'code under test did not exist' rule, it must independently apply at least one of the three reported mutants and reproduce the counts before gating.
